choose.when: SELECT p.writer_id AS reported_member_id FROM post p JOIN members m ON m.member_id = p.writer_id WHERE p.post_id = #{targetId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT c.writer_id AS reported_member_id FROM comment c JOIN members m ON m.member_id = c.writer_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{targetId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT m.member_id AS reported_member_id FROM members m WHERE m.member_id = #{targetId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT g.member_id AS reported_member_id FROM `groups` g JOIN members m ON m.member_id = g.member_id WHERE g.group_id = #{targetId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_case (report_type, target_id, reported_member_id) VALUES (#{reportType}, #{targetId}, #{reportedMemberId})
INSERT INTO member_report (case_id, reporter_id, reason) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT member_id FROM members WHERE system_role = 'ADMIN' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND account_status = 'ACTIVE'
